text_block_list.text:
Air Groove gave it her all in the Osaka 
Hai. Afterward, in the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...That performance clearly showed she's 
ready for a real race. However, the 
question is where she runs next.

The race a runner as talented as Silence 
Suzuka might target next is probably—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Someone like her will definitely 
run in the Takarazuka Kinen.
choice_data_list:
Let's show an even better run than today 
at the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.text:
As Air Groove began packing up to go home, 
I felt something was slightly off...
